persona: Python backend engineer at a SaaS company who handles enterprise customer integrations
resumeText:
Rohan Mehta | Bengaluru | rohan.mehta@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Senior Software Engineer, Integrations, Kaveri Data Systems, Bengaluru (2021 - present)
- Built Python services that sync customer ERP data into our analytics platform for 30 enterprise accounts.
- Wrote SQL transformations to map each customer's schema onto our data model.
- Designed REST APIs and webhooks that customer IT teams use to push orders and invoices.
- Deployed customer-specific connectors on AWS with ECS and S3, and debugged them in production.
- Ran discovery calls with customer engineers to scope integration requirements before each rollout.
- Presented rollout plans and trade-offs to customer engineering managers every fortnight.

Software Engineer, Kaveri Data Systems, Bengaluru (2019 - 2021)
- Built internal billing jobs in Python and PostgreSQL.

SKILLS
Python, SQL, AWS, Docker, LangChain, Generative AI

EDUCATION
BTech Computer Science, RV College of Engineering, 2019
